entities.summary: Joanne Lesley Malone CBE is a British perfumer and founder of the companies Jo Malone London, Jo Loves and Jo Vodka. Malone founded Jo Malone London in 1990 and later sold the company in 1999 to its current parent company Estee Lauder Companies. In 2011, Malone founded Jo Loves.
